map.Morse跌倒风险评分量表（6项，总分125分）: Morse Fall Risk Scale (6 items, total 125)
map.新入院或转科患者 24 小时内完成 Morse 评分，≥45 分列为高危并挂: Complete the Morse score within 24 h for new admissions or transfers; >=45 is high-risk and warrants a
map.术后下床活动前复评，静脉输液或镇痛泵未拔除者自动计入静脉治疗项。: Reassess before postoperative ambulation; those with IV infusion or analgesia pump still in place auto-count for the IV-therapy item.
map.服用镇静催眠或降压药后复评，步态与认知维度变化时及时上调风险。: Reassess after sedatives/hypnotics or antihypertensives; raise risk promptly when gait or cognition changes.

map.患者既往跌倒 1 次、使用助行器、留置针输液、步态需搀扶，六项累加得 55 分，: A patient with 1 prior fall, walker use, indwelling-needle infusion and assisted gait totals 55 across six items, rated high-risk, matching the ward assessment sheet.
map.本工具能替代医院 Morse 评估单吗？: Can this tool replace the hospital Morse sheet?
map.不能，仅作维度核对与培训演示，正式评分以护士床旁评估单与签字为准。: No; it only checks dimensions and demonstrates training. Formal scoring follows the nurse's bedside sheet and signature.
map.评分接近临界值（如 44/45）如何处理？: How to handle a score near the cutoff (e.g. 44/45)?
map.按就高不就低原则纳入高危管理，并以实际步态与认知观察为准。: Manage as high-risk (round up), and defer to actual gait and cognition observation.
map.儿童或 ICU 患者适用吗？: Does it apply to children or ICU patients?
map.Morse 主要适用于成人住院患者，儿童与 ICU 建议改用 Schmid 或: Morse mainly fits adult inpatients; for children and ICU use dedicated scales such as Schmid or Humphreys.
